4:05 I'm sorry. But this procedure is NOT a "stem cell" procedure or therapy. You can't harvest your stem cells simply from a blood draw from your arm. True stem cells must be harvested from bone marrow. Typically from your hip bone.   

The procedure you had in this video was a procedure called "Platelet Rich Plasma" or "PRP" injection. That's where they take blood from your arm, then spin it in a centrifuge to separate the blood cells from the plasma. Then the plasma is injected back into you. To date, the level of proof of the effectiveness of PRP injection is mixed, at best. Some medical professionals believe it to be a scam. This is the truth. I'm a physician in the USA.
